sections.h2: Painters close to home for the city of Alachua
body: Alachua is both a county and a city, and this page is about the city: the town around Historic Main Street, ZIP code 32615, up on the north side of the county. Searching for painters in Alachua, FL brings you to Precision Paint Experts, a company owned right here and run out of neighboring Newberry. Our Florida license, bond, and full insurance cover every Alachua job, and the painters on your ladders are our own people, never subcontracted help.
After 15+ years working these counties, we have a good idea which paints hold up through an Alachua August and which ones blister. For the wider county, see our Alachua County service page.

sections.h2: Main Street, Progress Park, and the big lots up north
body: Alachua has a wider mix of buildings than its size suggests. Older storefronts line Historic Main Street, where the trim, signboards, and street-facing facades are what people see first. The Progress Park corridor brings in commercial buildings that need repaints planned around working hours. Outside the center you'll find newer subdivisions like Turkey Creek, Cinnamon Hills, Heritage Oaks, and Savannah Station. Farther north there are large-lot homes with long fence lines, wide decks, and detached outbuildings.

People here care about curb appeal, and each property type needs different prep. On Main Street, old storefront trim gets scraped by hand and primed wherever wood shows through. Subdivision homes often have to stay within community color rules. On acreage, we're often staining as much wood as we paint.

sections.h2: Alachua summers and the paint on your walls
body: Through the summer the air here sits above 75% humidity for months at a stretch, and between June and September a thunderstorm rolls through three or four afternoons a week. Walls that face south and west take the strongest UV all year. Put those together and you get the failures we see most often: chalky siding that leaves powder on your palm, peeling along the bottom of fascia and door frames, widening stucco hairlines, and color that has bleached out on the sunny sides while the north wall still looks fine.

Before it is decoration, a coat of paint in Alachua is a rain shield. So clapboard, lap siding, and fascia are finished in 100% acrylic, stucco that keeps opening and closing at hairline cracks is coated in elastomeric, and raw wood gets a stain that soaks in rather than sitting on top. Our article on why humidity makes paint peel covers the science.

sections.h2: Steps on an Alachua painting job
body: Your first step is a walkthrough, and in Alachua those are generally on the books inside 48 hours. The visit is made by a crew lead rather than a salesperson, who measures the house, takes pictures of every side, and checks any doubtful wood or stucco with a moisture meter. A written, line-by-line estimate normally follows a business day later, listing surfaces, prep, products, coat count, and dates. Any additions require your sign-off in writing first.

Expect a start roughly one to three weeks after you accept. Crews spend the opening days on preparation, from washing and mildew treatment to scraping, swapping rotten fascia, fresh caulk, and spot primer. Two complete finish coats follow, and a third when the new color is a big departure. You and the crew lead finish with a punch walk; you sign once every item is fixed. For the outside of an Alachua home, our workmanship is guaranteed in writing for up to 10 years.

sections.h2: Neighboring towns on our Alachua routes
body: Our crews regularly work in the towns around Alachua. To the northwest, High Springs has craftsman homes and clapboard. To the south, Newberry is where we're based. A short drive southeast, Gainesville painting projects are one of the two biggest parts of our business. If your property sits between towns or outside city limits, ask for a free quote and we'll confirm coverage.

faqs.q: Is this page for the city of Alachua or the whole county?
faqs.a: It focuses on the city (ZIP 32615): Historic Main Street, the Progress Park corridor, and subdivisions such as Turkey Creek and Savannah Station. Elsewhere in Alachua County, our crews also paint in Gainesville, Newberry, High Springs, Archer, Hawthorne, and Micanopy.

faqs.q: How soon can a crew lead come out to my Alachua home or business?
faqs.a: Typically inside 48 hours, with your itemized number arriving one business day after the visit. Painting tends to begin one to three weeks from your approval.

faqs.q: Which months are best for an Alachua exterior repaint?
faqs.a: From October to May, the air is drier and storms are fewer. Summer exteriors still get done, but the crew starts at dawn and keeps checking the dew point and radar. Indoor jobs fit any month.

faqs.q: Are your painters licensed and insured?
faqs.a: Yes. We carry a Florida license, a bond, and full insurance, and workers' comp covers every painter on the job. A business or HOA in Alachua can request an insurance certificate in its own name before we start.
